source.title: Online Retail
source.creator: Daqing Chen
source.transformations: whole-invoice eligibility filtering, deterministic invoice sampling, exact derived subtotals

eligibility.selection: ascending SHA256(UTF-8 invoice_id), then invoice_id; first sample_size eligible invoices
eligibility.goods_stock_code_rule: five digits followed by zero to two ASCII letters; syntactic filter only
eligibility.numeric_rules: positive integral Quantity; positive finite decimal UnitPrice and InvoiceDate
eligibility.invoice_id_rule: six digits, with all C-prefixed cancellation invoices excluded
eligibility.customer_id_rule: five digits as provided by anonymized source
eligibility.duplicates: identical values in all eight columns exclude the whole invoice; business meaning unknown
eligibility.quality_counts: independent reasons can overlap; duplicate counts include original observations
eligibility.exact_subtotal: sum(Quantity * original XML UnitPrice decimal), with no line rounding
eligibility.display_subtotal: presentation assumption only: exact subtotal rounded once to GBP 0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP
eligibility.tax_discount_shipping: not invented; source rows with non-goods codes exclude their whole invoice
